[nation]Pantagruel[/nation] does this trade and investment deal work? [/quote]
We reject Sec.101 and Sec.102 on strategic goods, I'll instead levy for a 20%-30% tariff on the trade and exchange of those, while non-essential goods like luxury items will keep the 10% tariff. Only doing this to protect and foster my domestic industry. We also reject Sec.201-203 in favour of joint manufactury plants instead of  private foreign owned ones. These should keep at least a 65% local ownership rate. Instead of getting raw resources from me in large volumes, we could work on refining these resources in Pantagruel so I don't become reliant on the extraction sector to then be exported to Neue Republik. Like I said earlier, I insist we open joint venture refineries for oil and other raw resources too. We're also open to selling refined petroleum too. I also have to put a hard pass on Sec.302-305 as we operate a state run oil industry, and also the allowance of foreign firms to run resource extraction is a huge loss for us too. I can allow them as minority partners with a 49% max cap but our State run industries have to keep a 100% stake. Meridian may build ports for us but we will own them, but offers of leasing are available for a max 15 years. And you must locally employ Pantagrueli citizens too. Last thing I want to add is if your companies can invest into my board of education to help expand our resource extraction and STEM curriculum for more future skilled workers for our economy.

[b][u]Nordiheim Economic News[/u][/b]

A straight looking blond man in a marine suit is sitting behind a small news desk who have a bit of a "buisiness" look to him.
[i]Welcome to the economic news of Nordiheim, today we have some exiting news for all of you who are looking for a oportunity to make some money.[/i]
Bellow him on the bottom of the screen a constant stream of stock market data and resource price indexes are scrolling by at a speed almoust unreadable for those that are not used to it.

[i]Today I will tell you fine people about several news regarding new findings that will be important for the Nordiheim economy going forward, starting with those that hail from was ones the republic of Datia[/i]
Besides him on the screen a film comes up showing workers in a silk clothing factory followed by ongoing groundwork in the creation of a mining complex.
[i]While the industry involving Datian silk is stedily improving, with both raw silk and silk clothing being shiped out to a interested market, it is the creation of the company "Datia Mining" and the creation of its first mining complex that is the most interesting ting here.[/i]
The film now changes to showing various predictions.
[i]Not only are the company looking for investors interested in becoming part of its allready imminent expansion plans for future profits but experts are saying that, with plans allready being made for atleast 1 more mining complex further east from the one curently being made, there will be many jobb opportunities for people with several different educations wich the regional worker pool might not be able to meet, making for a great opportunity for those that might be living in a area that might have the opposite problem.[/i]

[i]And thats not all there is for mining in Nordiheim[/i]
The screen besides the man now shows a paning shot of the area of the far south in the nation, wich lays at the other side of Lake Lifvatn, some machine and people can be seen on the ground doing some kind of digging.
[i]Deep down south in the part of the Sorland region that is on the other side of the great lake Lifvatn geologists have found deposits of the resource [b]Phosphorus[/b], a mineral that Nordiheim have historicaly been laking inn large quanteties and wich have usualy been hard to get ahold of for our industry, this lucky discovery have allready been acted upon by the council who have assigned the national company "Nordiheim National Mining Company", or NNMC, to start planing the mining of the phosphorus for both internal use and potential export[/i]
The screen switches to a image of the blue and orange flag of Hydronia.
[i]The well known nation of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] have apparently initiated talks with our goverment to forward their interest in investing in the venture in exange for shares aswell as "first dibs" on future exports for their own countries use according to anonymous insiders that we have managed to contact.
This would sugest that the deposit is most likely of a significant size and quality for it to aquire such attention.[/i]

The side screen now changes to pictures showing military industrial factories.
[i]The nations military industrial complex is also going hot with the "National Armor Company" still producing the Emu 2-As for [nation]Italian dutch[/nation] at full capacity with several shipments having allready been sendt to the shamatan nation with the next one almoust ready for shipment allready.
The dockyards of "Nordrlandi Shipyard Company" and "Ostra Redri AS" reporting that increase in orders will make earlier years fisical numbers look rather sad compared to those they are expecting this year.[/i]

The side screen changes to a picture of a fancy red graph going upwards.
[i]Some economists sugiests caution though as the curent tempo of the economy is still rather reliant on more trade deals being made for this high to become more of a norm then a one hit wonder.
This proberly would explain the incredibly high activity in the department of foreign affairs as the council is most likely [b]very[/b] aware of the same fact.[/i]

The screen focuses on the blond man.
[i]That is all for today, I hope that this have been informative for you and remember what they say over in the west, "Break your leggs"[/i]
Whit this slightly cheesy and wrongly quoted idiom the blond man signs off.
